title: Amazon CloudWatch

fields.name: add_entity
fields.description: Add entity to PutLogEvent calls.

fields.name: alias
fields.description: Sets an alias, use for multiple instances of the same output plugin.

fields.name: auto_create_group
fields.description: Automatically create the log group. Allowed values: true, false (case insensitive).

fields.name: auto_retry_requests
fields.description: Immediately retry failed requests to AWS services once. This option doesn't affect the normal Fluent Bit retry mechanism with backoff. Instead, it enables an immediate retry with no delay for networking errors, which can help improve throughput when there are transient/random networking issues.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Specify a custom endpoint for the CloudWatch Logs API.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Specify an external ID for the STS API, can be used with the role_arn parameter if your role requires an external ID.

fields.name: extra_user_agent
fields.description: This option appends a string to the default user agent. AWS asks that you not manually set this field yourself, it's reserved for use in vended configurations, for example, EKS Container Insights.

fields.name: log_format
fields.description: An optional parameter that can be used to tell CloudWatch the format of the data. A value of json/emf enables CloudWatch to extract custom metrics embedded in a JSON payload.

fields.name: log_group_class
fields.description: Specifies the log storage class for new log groups when auto_create_group is set to true. You can't modify the storage class of existing log groups. Allowed values: STANDARD, INFREQUENT_ACCESS.

fields.name: log_group_name
fields.description: The name of the CloudWatch log group that you want log records sent to.

fields.name: log_group_template
fields.description: Template for CW Log Group name using record accessor syntax. Plugin falls back to the log_group_name configured if needed.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: By default, the whole log record will be sent to CloudWatch. If you specify a key name with this option, then only the value of that key will be sent to CloudWatch. For example, if you are using the Fluentd Docker log driver, you can specify log_key log and only the log message will be sent to CloudWatch.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Specifies the log level for output plugin. If not set here, plugin uses global log level in service section.

fields.name: log_retention_days
fields.description: If set to a number greater than zero, and newly create log group's retention policy is set to this many days. Allowed values: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

fields.name: log_stream_name
fields.description: The name of the CloudWatch log stream that you want log records sent to.

fields.name: log_stream_prefix
fields.description: Prefix for the log stream name. The tag is appended to the prefix to construct the full log stream name. Not compatible with the log_stream_name option.

fields.name: log_stream_template
fields.description: Template for CloudWatch Log Stream name using record accessor syntax. Plugin falls back to the log_stream_name or log_stream_prefix configured if needed.

fields.name: log_suppress_interval
fields.description: Suppresses log messages from output plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval. 0 no suppression.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Set a tag pattern to match records that output should process. Exact matches or wildcards (for example *).

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Set a regular expression to match tags for output routing. This allows more flexible matching compared to wildcards.

fields.name: metric_dimensions
fields.description: Metric dimensions is a list of lists. If you have only one list of dimensions, put the values as a comma separated string. If you want to put list of lists, use the list as semicolon separated strings. If your value is d1,d2;d3, it will consider it as [[d1, d2],[d3]].

fields.name: metric_namespace
fields.description: An optional string representing the CloudWatch namespace for the metrics. See the Metrics tutorial section for a full configuration.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Option to specify an AWS Profile for credentials.

fields.name: region
fields.description: The AWS region to send logs to. China regions (cn-north-1, cn-northwest-1) and the AWS European Sovereign Cloud region (eusc-de-east-1) are supported; Fluent Bit automatically uses the correct endpoint suffix (.amazonaws.com.cn or .amazonaws.eu) and no custom endpoint is required.

fields.name: retry_limit
fields.description: Set retry limit for output plugin when delivery fails. Integer, no_limits, false, or off to disable, or no_retries to disable retries entirely.

fields.name: role_arn
fields.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume for cross account access.

fields.name: sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify a custom STS endpoint for the AWS STS API.

fields.name: tls.windows.certstore_name
fields.description: Sets the certificate store name on an output (Windows).

fields.name: tls.windows.use_enterprise_store
fields.description: Sets whether using enterprise certificate store or not on an output (Windows).

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Amazon CloudWatch.
